iti35:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti35:2.1: “Monks, this holy life is lived, not for the sake of deceiving people, not for the sake of inveigling people, not for the sake of the rewards of gain, offerings, & tribute, nor with the thought, ‘Thus may people know me.’
iti35:2.2: This holy life is lived for the sake of restraint & abandoning.”
iti35:3.1:
For the sake of restraint,
for the sake of abandoning,
he, the Blessed One, taught
a holy life not handed down,
iti35:4.1:
This path is pursued
by those great in purpose,
iti35:4.4: as taught by the One Awakened,
iti35:4.6:
will put an end
to suffering & stress.
